Subject: Hiring committee summary & recommendation — Staff ML (Priya Sharma)

All — thanks for the feedback. Based on the compiled notes, scores, and compensation constraints I'm recommending we close this req at Staff level as NO HIRE. Rationale: 1) compensation ask exceeds our Staff band and pushing band would create upward pressure; 2) operational production experience gap increases our ramp risk for the two high-priority infra projects; 3) headcount prioritization for this quarter favors own-hire senior infra role.

Action items:
- Laura: please send a polite closeout to the candidate and confirm the talent partner record updated (cold pool).
- Marcus & Vivek: confirm whether you'd like the candidate flagged for future Senior ML reqs (I think Marcus favored that).
- Aditya: I will open a redlined note to People Ops so we don't reallocate the headcount without a follow-up approval.

I'll copy recruiting on this closeout and will log the committee decision to the hiring doc.

Hannah Schmitt
Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

Subject: Update on Staff ML role at Redwood — decision

Hi Priya,

Thank you for taking the time to interview with our team for the Staff ML Engineer role. After careful consideration, the hiring committee has decided not to extend an offer for the Staff level at this time. This decision was difficult — your architecture and systems thinking were strong. The committee's main concerns were around production-level operational experience at our scale and alignment with the Staff compensation band.

We'd like to keep your resume on file and will reach out if a more senior or product-focused ML position opens that better aligns with your background. If you'd like feedback from the interviews, I'm happy to share a short summary.

Attachments: interview-feedback-merged.docx

Best,
Laura Bennett
Director, Talent Partner
Redwood Inference
